thread.title: The Keys to Apple's Quarterly Earnings Report on Thursday

author: Home
title: The Keys to Apple's Quarterly Earnings Report on Thursday
text:
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) reports quarterly earnings on Thursday after the close, and all eyes will be on iPhone sales, as well as guidance for the December quarter.
Eric Jhonsa, TheStreet's tech columnist, thinks there should be room for the tech giant to beat consensus estimates for the September quarter for iPhone unit sales of 47 million. For the quarter as a whole, analysts polled by FactSet are expecting EPS of $2.78 and revenues of $61.46 billion.
Listen to our podcast below for an in-depth preview of Apple's earnings; TheStreet will also be live blogging the report and earnings call after the market close on Thursday.
